basic_info.description: This top-floor, garden-facing condominium offers a quiet, peaceful setting in the heart of San Francisco.  The living room features a rounded Queen Anne bay and decorative fireplace. The spacious dining room features a large window and box beamed ceiling. The kitchen is flooded with natural light. The two bedrooms are located across the hallway from each other providing nice separation. Down the hall the is where you will find the spacious bathroom with shower over tub and large laundry room. The unit has abundant storage throughout and a separate storage unit on the ground level- perfect for bicycles and seasonal gear. This prime Lower Pacific Heights location has easy access to public transit and downtown and is only a few blocks to boutique dining and shopping on Fillmore Street, Lafayette Park, Whole Foods, and Japan Town.
